conviction_note: Near non-result: Hulic Reit runs an explicit 'DPU 4,000 yen or more' policy funded by reserve drawdowns and sponsor asset swaps, every swap since April was filed as 'impact minor, forecast unchanged', and the stock's last seven post-release sessions moved under 1% (excess vs the J-REIT ETF within +/-1pt), so the two small positives (a full period of the Sept swap's +423m NOI in the first Aug-2027 guide, and a record of meeting or beating its own DPU guide) give p_up 55 on an abs move of 0.8, i.e. +0.08; the impact_sum of +0.40 is larger because each finding is sized alone and neither is shrunk to the scaled number.
bar: Company forecast DPU 4,000 yen for the Aug-2026 (25th) and Feb-2027 (26th) periods, net income 5,631m / 5,113m, from the 2026-02 決算短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260416/140120260415504531.pdf ; reaffirmed unchanged in the 2026-09-25 swap release https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260925/140120260925540051.pdf . No 四季報/IFIS consensus reachable, so the bar is the company plan only and every size here is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-10-16 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html via baseline). 信用倍率 49.19x (kabutan https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3295, 2026-10-19), a crowded retail margin long typical of a 5.7%-yielding J-REIT. No options, no skew. Run-up -4.94% 20d vs J-REIT ETF 1343 -4.3% (Yahoo chart), so the drawdown is sector/rates, not name-specific. No negative finding filed, so the crowded margin long is not a squeeze argument against anything.

findings.finding: The 2026-09-30 sponsor swap (QUARTZ SHINSAIBASHI 24.99% + Eastnet Building in, three older assets out) adds an estimated +423m yen NOI per period (+4.7% of portfolio NOI, ~+290 yen/unit before depreciation) and a 199m exchange gain, and the first guide for the Aug-2027 (27th) period, issued with this print, is the first to carry a full period of it, under a stated policy of DPU >= 4,000.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: April 2026 print held DPU guide at 4,000 despite forecast net income down 7% and 9%: next session +0.24% vs ETF -0.74% (excess +1.0). Oct 2025 print (new 4,000 guide): +0.35% vs ETF +0.67%. April 2025 print: -0.88%. Yahoo 3295.T / 1343.T daily closes.
findings.why_not_priced: The swap and its NOI arithmetic are public since 9/25, so the NOI itself is largely priced; what is not known is whether management turns it into a 27th-period DPU guide above 4,000 or a higher adjusted EPU. If the market were pricing a raise, 3295 would have outperformed the J-REIT ETF since 9/25; it fell with it (ETF -4.3% 20d, 3295 -4.9%).
findings.independence: Same-company documents only: the 9/25 main release says the Feb-2027 forecast is unchanged (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260925/140120260925540051.pdf), and the 2025-10 briefing transcript states the 'DPU 4,000 yen or more' policy continues after the two-year plan (https://finance.logmi.jp/382734). Interest-cost headwind cuts the other way: 2026-08-26 refinancing at TIBOR+0.21% (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260826/140120260826526178.pdf).

findings.finding: Hulic Reit has met or beaten its own DPU guide at each of the last three prints (Feb-2025 4,000 vs 4,000; Aug-2025 4,000 vs 4,000; Feb-2026 4,050 vs 4,000) and raised the Aug-2026 net income forecast from 5,444m (Oct 2025) to 5,631m (Apr 2026) while holding DPU at 4,000, so the Aug-2026 actual most likely lands at or slightly above 4,000.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 50-yen Feb-2026 beat was printed 2026-04-16 at 15:30 and the stock rose +0.24% next session against the ETF -0.74%; the at-guide Aug-2025 print 2025-10-17 16:00 was followed by +0.35% vs ETF +0.67%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: a beat lands inside a DPU policy everyone reads, which is why this is sized near zero. A 4,050-type beat is not visible beforehand, because J-REITs publish no monthly series and no forecast revision was filed for the 25th period (kabutan disclosure list through 2026-10-19 shows none).
findings.independence: Prior forecast table in the Aug-2025 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251017/140120251015574118.pdf) shows the 5,444m starting point; same issuer, so not independent of the issuer's own conservatism.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: Feb-2027 DPU 4,000 likely held (9/25 release said unchanged). Returns: DPU >= 4,000 policy; a buyback or a 27th-period guide above 4,000 is the only upside item, neither signalled. New guide: first Aug-2027 forecast is issued with this print and carries a full period of the +423m NOI swap. Quarter: Aug-2026 DPU vs 4,000 guide, issuer has met or beaten for three prints (no 進捗率 analogue for a REIT half-year).
baseline_tension: The baseline lean is -0.59 (margin overhang dominates) and the run-up is -4.9%, matching the sector's rate-driven fall; the findings lean mildly positive. The strongest positive the release could carry is a 27th-period DPU guide above 4,000 or a buyback, and I looked: nothing pre-signals either, and the strongest negative (rising refinancing costs) is already in the declining net income guidance. Mostly this agrees with the price: an honest near-zero.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: both findings are positive and neither rests on a public monthly series (rule 1 does not apply), and rule 2's check (look for the strongest positive) was already done and is recorded in baseline_tension
